name: powershell-format
description: Format and lint PowerShell at git pre-commit via PSScriptAnalyzer, only when a PSScriptAnalyzerSettings.psd1 governs the repo; optionally check uncommitted changes when a turn ends.

powershell_format_enabled.title: Enable powershell-format hooks
powershell_format_enabled.description: Turns the end-of-turn check and the session-start probe on or off. The git pre-commit entry is registered by /powershell-format:setup apply install-git-hooks and is not affected.

powershell_format_end_of_turn.title: Check PowerShell in uncommitted changes at turn end
powershell_format_end_of_turn.description: At the end of each turn, run the pre-commit PSScriptAnalyzer check over the lines changed since the last commit and hand any findings back so they are fixed before the turn ends, at most once per turn. Nothing is rewritten. Off by default.
